title: 卡萨丁·歇脚看罗盘
description: 戴呼吸面罩的卡萨丁穿完整紫色护甲，在凳上查看圆罗盘，腕刃收拢不发光。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kassadin is an adult armored wanderer with a distinctive horned purple helmet, a dark breathing mask, glowing blue-violet eye slits, and layered Void-touched armor. Preserve the masked head and broad shoulder silhouette with a fully covering opaque tunic, gauntlets, trousers, and boots. His energy blade is fully retracted or represented by an inactive wrist housing, with no cutting glow or attack pose.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low travel stool and turns a small unlettered compass in his gloved hands, considering its simple needle with a thoughtful tilt. A closed satchel and rolled cloth rest nearby. A pale arch and two smooth stones suggest a quiet stopping place, keeping the masked character approachable and the equipment safely inactive.
art_direction.palette: deep violet, blue glow, sand cream, muted brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
